definitivtim_fanfare.configuration.title: DefinitivTim's Fanfare
definitivtim_fanfare.configuration.toast: A quest or chapter picks its toast with a tag: toast_task, toast_goal, toast_challenge or toast_standard. Tags are set in the quest editor.
definitivtim_fanfare.configuration.defau: Toast for quests without a toast tag. FTB_STANDARD keeps the toast of FTB Quests.
Toast for chapters without a toast tag. FTB_STANDARD keeps the toast of FTB Quests.
definitivtim_fanfare.configuration.sound: No extra sound for task, level up for goal, fanfare for challenge.
definitivtim_fanfare.configuration.iconF: Draws the advancement frame of the kind around the quest icon.
definitivtim_fanfare.configuration.displ: How long the toast stays on screen.
